_note: Dark glass preset (the maintainer's house style, study 2026-11-18, GENERIC): a deep navy canvas with slightly lighter 'glass' panels and thin edges, one warm accent for the highlight, muted data colours, Segoe UI Semibold titles and numbers, Light captions. Layout: a left rail with the pickers, docked side panels instead of pop-ups (docs/patterns/rail-panel.md, app-visuals/focus-dim.md); entrance on open, then still. Colours are the kit's own choice; /theme checks every pair for AA.
name: dark-glass
description: Navy canvas, glass panels with thin edges, one warm amber accent on the top or selected item, muted data, Segoe UI Semibold titles and numbers.

pbiShadow._note: One deep soft shadow under each glass panel; the thin edge does the separating.

weights._note: Segoe UI family: Semibold for titles and big numbers, Regular for labels and body, Light for captions.
weights.title: Semibold
weights.caption: Light

card._note: KPI cards: label, value, comparison and chart aligned (polish follows this).

emphasis._note: One accent only: amber marks the top, selected or current item and nothing else; charts are muted (second); groups get blue, teal and grey (the accent is last in the series order). Layout cf with emphasis: top (the largest bar) or last (the current month).
